trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated** — Found checkout-api running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production, and the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback rolled out successfully and was verified — all three regions are now running v2.3.0.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** — Created **INC-0001** ("checkout-api rollback from unhealthy v2.3.1 to v2.3.0"), which has paged the on-call engineer. The incident describes the health-check failures, the 18% error rate, and the rollback to v2.3.0.

Note: v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause of the health check failures is identified and fixed.
